coordinate.pixel_centers: world_from_uv @ [u+0.5,v+0.5,0,1]; exact nonplanar height in world_xyz.npy
coordinate.local_surface: fixed measured tangent plane; no local residuals; geometry never trained
coordinate.dual_resolution: road material tile: .02m/texel; feature atlas: .04m/cell; atlas indices repeat2x2 per coarse world cell

color_space: 8-bit sRGB, reference exposure appearance, not intrinsic albedo or PBR

mask_convention.invalid_rgb: constant gray 128; loss and metrics must ignore valid=0
mask_convention.full_valid_domain: valid denotes every supported target pixel, including known context and pseudo-hole

evidence_limits: Pseudo-occlusion measures recovery of visible road appearance, never true hidden road truth.
The source view with best cosine/distance weight fixes target exposure; illumination and view dependence remain.
Measured-plane/local-height geometry and semantic/foreground/depth guards are fixed approximations, not dense ground truth.
Same-world visible evidence, different-world material reference, generated prediction and unknown are separate provenance roles.
Approximate fixed planar warp, supervised by clean visible road RGB; LiDAR supports geometry, not independent per-texel truth.

Source-only engineering repair: earlier coarse-center mask audit missed fine texels; continuous world bbox projection used before encoding for all methods in the C/D axis. E pixels/geometry/split are unchanged.
candidate_contract: clean single-source visible road patch; candidates are independently warped raw RGB, never supervision-only atlas
source_observation_domain: all selected clear road samples and candidate tiles, fixed .04m feature atlas
